name: safe-submit
title: Safe Submit
description: Submit button that runs one request at a time, ignores repeat clicks, Enter spam and double-taps, and hands your onSubmit an idempotency key that is reused on retry after a network error or 408/429/5xx so the server can dedupe.

meta.stops: Helps prevent paying twice after a timeout
meta.summary: Collapses repeated clicks, Enter spam and double-taps into one request and reuses an idempotency key on retry, so your server can dedupe.
meta.server: Store the idempotency key with the result and return the stored result for repeats; add a unique constraint so duplicate writes fail.
catches: Repeat clicks and Enter presses while a request is in flight (synchronous guard)
Double-taps right after a request settles (cooldown, default 400 ms)
Ambiguous failures (network, timeout, 408/429/5xx), retried with the same key
Definite failures, which mint a fresh key for the next attempt
limits: Does not guarantee a single charge or record; that requires the server to honour the idempotency key
The key lives in memory: a reload, remount or second tab gets a new key
Classifies retryable errors with a default rule; pass isRetryable for your API
a11y: Uses aria-busy instead of disabled while pending, so the button keeps focus
Pending, success and retry states have visible text labels; icons are aria-hidden
Errors render with role=alert and are linked via aria-describedby
